conf.description: CISA Protective DNS Resolver dns-resolution / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: cisa-pdns / dns-resolution / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Cloudflare Logpush integration (cloudflare_logpush), gateway_dns data stream). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
